newsitem.title: ESTONIA: GOVERNMENT APPROVES REGIONAL TAX EXEMPTION.
newsitem.headline: GOVERNMENT APPROVES REGIONAL TAX EXEMPTION.

text.p: Estonia's government on Tuesday approved a draft law on income tax exemption on investments for companies operating in regions outside the capital, Prime Minister Mart Siimann said.
The draft law gives the government the right to decide which regions will be exempted from tax, Siimann told a news conference.
"There is no final decision but there is a high probability that the areas will be all districts except Harju (surrounding Tallinn)," he said.
"As to towns, Tallinn, Tartu and Parnu will not be considered under tax exemptions," he added.
"If the experiment succeeds, one cannot rule out...that it will be extended to the whole of Estonia," Siimann added.
